decision: STRING MIGRATION ('block' -> block-none, spec §1.5), AGREES. iastate_ext sweet corn: "Space seeds 8 to 12 inches apart in rows 2½ to 3 feet apart." -> in_row [8,12], rows [30,36]; pollination_block_min_rows 4 stays crop-root (§1.3; ISU 'plant several short rows or blocks'). No hill entry: plants_per_hill must be PLANTS after thinning, and the only corn hill sentence on a cited page (ISU sweet corn: 'Sow 4 to 5 seeds per hill ... Hills should be spaced 2½ feet apart') gives SEEDS per hill with no thin-to count (worklist 56 §5). Figure unchanged: no restatements owed. [RULED 2026-10-01 (Trevor, session 3 review): NO HILL ENTRY, and promote 2 must not re-add one: 'Sow 4 to 5 seeds per hill' (ISU sweet corn) is a SOWING count, not plants_per_hill (plants after thinning); the spec's §1.4 corn example is illustrative and loses to the page. THINNING TEXT (recorded, not edited): thinning.to_spacing and its tips cite tamu_agrilife EHT-044, whose page says 'After the plants are up, thin them to 1 foot apart', while this entry's in-row figure is the ISU/UMN page's. Two cited pages, two fields: the thinning text stays as its own citation states.]
